# Microsoft GitHub

> > Microsoft's open source projects and documentation hub, featuring AutoGen multi-agent framework, PyTorch resources, and developer tools.

This site hosts documentation and resources for Microsoft's open source initiatives, with a primary focus on AutoGen, a framework for building AI agent applications using large language models. The site includes guides for developers working with multi-agent systems, code execution environments, and LLM-based applications.

## Key Topics

- AutoGen
- Multi-agent framework
- AI agents
- LLM applications
- PyTorch
- AssistantAgent
- UserProxyAgent
- GPT-4
- OpenAI
- Code execution
- LocalCommandLineCodeExecutor
- Docker
- Getting started
- Quickstart guide
- Installation

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started | AutoGen 0.2](https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/0.2/docs/Getting-Started/): AutoGen quickstart guide covering installation and AI agent setup
